messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P-90827 fired (critical) for hosted-api-us-west — symptom: 99p latency > 1.1s for 30s. Trigger window=30s. Links: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/P-90827 · runbook: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/hosted-latency · escalation: oncall-sre
Kevin: acked (taking). seeing a narrow 99p spike across 3 router pods in us-west-2, started ~03:27 UTC. CPU looks normal but there are repeated container restarts on router-4 and router-5. digging logs now.
Maria: looking at runtime traces — big KV cache warmups at the same time, lots of coldstarts (kv-miss heatmap). could be a recent deploy or a thundering-start from a canary. checking deploy history.
Jamie: checking customer signals — no spike in 5xxs across tenancy, support queue clean. a couple of internal dashboards show 1-2 slow requests for small customers but nothing pagable. tagging product for FYI.
Kevin: quick mitigation — scaling routers by +2 to absorb churn. running:
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/hosted-routers -n prod --replicas=12
# or: gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize hosted-router-pool --size=12 --zone=us-west2-a
```
Kevin: scaling started, will watch until replicas ready. also disabled short-lived canary rollout (if present) via pipeline pause.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P-90827 acknowledged by Kevin (oncall).
pagerduty-bot: PD note: escalation suppressed after ack.
Maria: I pulled the deploy history — there was a small config rollout 6m before the spike that touched kernel tuning on the runners (not the runtime). reverting that change to be safe.
Jamie: can we confirm customer impact? I scanned logs for >=1.5s requests and saw ~18 events across 10m, mostly internal e2e tests. flagging support just in case but marking low impact.
Kevin: replicas are up, KV warmup rate dropped, 99p normalized within ~70s of scale-up. PD incident auto-clear might happen if condition holds.
incident-bot: Alert condition cleared — auto-resolve will run (no manual close).
incident-bot: Alert P-90827 auto-resolved after 92s (condition cleared).
Maria: follow-ups: add a 60s cooldown to the 99p rule and increase sample window to 5m to reduce sensitivity to short-lived warmups. also add a short playbook step to check recent rollouts before paging.
Jamie: created ticket INC-2026: "Transient latency spike — tune 99p alert & add rollout check" and assigned to eng-runtime. link: https://issues.local/INC-2026 
Kevin: added PD annotation: `pd annotate P-90827 "auto-resolved; no sustained customer impact; follow-up INC-2026"`
Maria: will monitor next 24h and follow up in the ticket with heatmap + deployment timeline.
Kevin: handing off monitoring to Maria, I need to sign off in 20m. ping me if it flaps back. :wave:
Jamie: thanks all — looks like quick autoscale + revert did the trick. adding note to oncall runbook about noisy KV warmups. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Summary: P-90827 fired → ack by Kevin → scale-up + revert config → condition cleared → auto-resolved. No customer-facing outage reported.
